summary: [[character:riker]] manages fractious negotiations among prospective emigrant groups. He rejects Valter's attempt to use the Svalbard vaults to secure priority passage, weighs [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]]'s proposal to accelerate a third colony ship, and refuses [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]'s attempted obedience override. Valter later indicates that a closer third-ship schedule may allow a compromise.

introducing.name: Spitsbergen refuge
introducing.description: The Spitsbergen refuge, also called the Spits, is a survivor group technically within [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] that does not recognize [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]]'s authority.

introducing.name: Svalbard Global Trust
introducing.description: The Svalbard Global Trust is an organization associated with vaults that prospective colonists regard as valuable.

introducing.name: Minister Cranston
introducing.current_state: After invoking [[technology:protocol-override-four-alpha-twenty-three]], he fails to compel [[character:riker]] and has his call terminated.

introducing.name: buried imperatives
introducing.description: Buried imperatives are control directives that [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]] programmers installed in a [[technology:replicant-matrix]]. A protocol override is intended to activate one and compel [[character:riker]]'s obedience.

introducing.name: protocol override four alpha twenty-three
introducing.description: Protocol override four alpha twenty-three is a code phrase intended to activate a buried imperative and make [[character:riker]] obedient.

updates.current_state: Its enclave outside Augsburg is to leave [[location:earth]] first for supplying the colony-ship plans, against many groups' objections. The [[organization:spitsbergen-refuge]] is technically part of USE but rejects [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]]'s authority.

Leading a surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] group from an underground military installation while coordinating with [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]]. His group would fill the first two colony ships, and he refuses to surrender passage or leave part of it behind.

Leading the [[organization:spitsbergen-refuge]] while seeking survival and emigration assurances for its people. He demands priority passage in return for access to the Svalbard vaults, but later signals willingness to discuss a closer third-ship schedule.

The ships can move only a small fraction of [[location:earth]]'s survivors at a time, so most must be kept alive meanwhile. [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]] proposes speeding up a third ship by a year at the cost of delaying the first two by almost four months.

updates.description: A spare hardware unit carried aboard [[vessel:heaven-1]] that can contain a complete [[technology:guppi-interface|GUPPI]] system. [[character:riker]]'s matrix once contained [[technology:buried-imperatives]] installed by [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]] programmers; [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]] removed some of them during the journey to [[location:epsilon-eridani]].

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]], organizing surviving [[location:earth]] enclaves into a [[organization:united-nations]] while managing fractious negotiations over survival and eventual evacuation.
